title: Master Levels for Doom II
description: Released by id Software as an expansion pack for Doom II, Master Levels for Doom II contains 21 levels spread across 20 WAD files. Created by various authors under contract, this collection features individual maps, including a secret level contained within TEETH.WAD.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release (masterlevels.wad, the compiled single-WAD edition). [DoomWiki](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/Master_Levels_for_Doom_II)
